name: site_id
label: Site
help: The site, from the sites this API token can open. You can also map a site ID (pa_...) from an earlier module.

name: date
label: Date
help: The day the note is shown on. Defaults to today.

name: end_date
label: End Date
help: For a note that covers several days, the last day.

name: title
label: Title
help: Short title shown on the chart. Defaults to a generated text for deploy notes.

name: url
label: URL
help: A link such as a pull request or changelog page.

name: color
label: Color
help: Pin color, one of neutral, brand, blue, amber, red or violet. Defaults to neutral (blue for deploy notes).

name: source
label: Source
help: manual (default) for notes written by a person, or deploy for release notifications. system, import and incident are reserved for notes the app writes itself.

name: version
label: Version
help: Only used when source is deploy and title is empty. A release version or commit, used to build the default title.
